verdict.rationale: Jules runs each task asynchronously in its own cloud VM and notifies you on completion. Its usage-limits page has a 'Power users & agent-heavy workflows' tier showing figures of 300 and 60, which plausibly are daily and concurrent task caps, though the snippet is fragmentary. The API allows programmatic task dispatch. Community users report it 'handles large quantities of tasks very well' and that several PRs pile up for review, while the free plan's daily cap was cut from 60 to 15, which limits scale on lower tiers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of concurrent-task limits and how parallel sessions are managed, independent hands-on evidence of many tasks running simultaneously, and clarity on caps per plan tier.
